# DSH icon source copy

`index.tsx` and `props.ts` are unchanged copies of official DeepSeek Harness `packages/client/ui-primitives/src/icons` at `b150a551b8d465e31e418e1b2eaf5e79bbb7d28e`.

They live inside the Vite source root so the standalone app compiles them with its own TypeScript configuration instead of the upstream monorepo project references. MIT terms are in `vendor/deepseek-harness-ui/official/LICENSE`.
